newsitem.title: USA: Homestake Mining Q1 shr $0.34 vs $0.09.
newsitem.headline: Homestake Mining Q1 shr $0.34 vs $0.09.

text.p: NOTE: Current Q1 results include net after-tax gains of $47.2 million or $0.32 per share from break-up fee received from Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp upon termination of Homestake's merger agreement with Santa Fe, and $8.1 million or $0.06 per share from sale of the George Lake and Back River joint venture interests in the Northwest Territories of Canada to Arauco Resources Corp. Results for the first quarter of 1996 include an after-tax gain of $4.9 million or $0.03 per share from a litigation recovery.

Excluding the effect of nonrecurring items, Homestake incurred a net loss of $5.4 million or $0.04 per share from operations in the first quarter of 1997 vs net income of $8.8 million or $0.06 per share.

1997 results reflect the impact of a $48 per ounce decline in the average gold price received, continued heavy investment in exploration, and higher depreciation and amortization charges resulting from the acquisition of additional interests in the company's Australian operations and in the Snip mine in Canada during 1996.
